audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows named Yorick or Skill on a 56.7% Yone matchup whose every why, spike and prose block says Yone controls the lane. The difficulty rating said 8.5/10 (hard) while diff said FAV.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Yone, Yone, Yone, Yone, Skill, Yone, Yone]; whys[0] through whys[6] describe Yone winning every stage except level 6, which they call even.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 -> Yone at 7/10, row 4 -> Skill at 5/10, as matched full+content pairs; diffRating dropped to 4/10 with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t brought into line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 phase gave no cost for Maiden, so the one window that is genuinely his read as generic.
audit.why: Eulogy of the Isles is 160/130/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane, and the whole reason level 6 is a stop-and-wait beat rather than a power flip.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and dontsFull[1].d rewritten with the 160s figure and what to do while it runs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession was written as a trap that 'traps you for ghouls' with no cooldown and no statement that it is destructible terrain; Mourning Mist's mark — the actual reason his ghouls reach you — was never given as the cue, and Last Rites' auto-reset and heal were absent.
audit.why: Dark Procession is 20/18/16/14/12s and is terrain that blocks movement and dashes; Mourning Mist is 12/11/10/9/8s, cuts armour, slows and marks you so summoned units speed toward the mark; Last Rites is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s, resets his attack and heals him.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with the timers, the terrain behaviour and the mark cue.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dark Procession and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Dark Procession and how disciplined your pattern is.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Yorick carry threat 8.5/10.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yorick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Maiden is 160s at rank 1 and doubles his duel damage — do not fight into her. Once she expires the lane is yours again.

edits.before: Traps you for ghouls. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1 and it is terrain — it blocks dashes.

edits.before: Yorick wastes Dark Procession (Cage) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: It is a wall, not a stun — step around the edge and commit through it.

edits.before: That is Yorick's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Last Rites resets his auto and heals him every 6s — step off the wind-up.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Maiden is 160s at rank 1 — wait her out, then take the duel.

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Mourning Mist (E): 12s at rank 1 — the mark speeds his ghouls onto you, so that is the real cue. - Dark Procession (W): 20s at rank 1, terrain that blocks dashes. - Eulogy of the Isles (R): 160s.

notes: packet suspectName 'Use Spirit Cleave' in early is a FALSE POSITIVE — Spirit Cleave is Yone's real W. Two things for the user: (1) tone is '#ff5d6c' (the red used on HARD pages) on a matchup the same record calls FAV at a 56.7% win rate — I did not guess the FAV palette value, so tone still needs setting by hand. (2) Four fields (whys[3], spikes[2], mid, late, wants.you[1]) claim Soul Unbound walks out of Dark Procession's wall. Riot's text says only that the spirit leaves the body with bonus move speed; nothing states whether it ignores terrain. Left unedited and recorded as unverified rather than deleted.
